condition: Live Olympus route in desktop Edge with Quest base-geometry budget and profiling mode (no debug boundary meshes). Real network DEM and imagery, normal selection, worker terrain publication and tour following; paired images hold the same scene/state synchronously. CPU preparation is a synchronous batch-settle stress operation, not normal per-frame or native GPU timing. Detail monitoring samples at 250 ms; it is not full-tour or native acceptance.

renderBenchmark.condition: Warmed fixed scene, 60 requestAnimationFrame-paced renders per pass; no simulation/LOD updates or native XR. Submission is main-thread elapsed render time. GPU samples use EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 when available.
